title: Puck: enable CONFIG_LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT on the constrained board confs (SLIP MUST)
description: Child 2 of b7z9.41 (spec/11-lci.md 17.7: constrained node MUST implement SLIP framing). CONFIG_LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT is enabled only on lichen/apps/puck/boards/rak4631_nrf52840.conf:18-19; missing on t1000_e_nrf52840.conf (which instead sets CONFIG_LICHEN_NATIVE=y per R-11-001 deprecation note — do NOT remove NATIVE here, separate finding), t_echo, r1_neo, thinknode (verify exact board list via ls lichen/apps/puck/boards/). Add CONFIG_LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT=y to each constrained-board conf. Note the a2a2 dependency: LICHEN_COAP_KEYS depends on SLIP_TRANSPORT — enabling SLIP makes KEYS available but KEYS itself stays gated by its own prj.conf setting. Verify: puck native_sim build still green + one board-conf compile check if the SDK allows (nrf52840 cross-compile), else Kconfig-level validation via the native_sim build with the board conf fragments applied. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.41.
